name: xpress-bi
description: Xpress BI connects ChatGPT to Contador Xpress so you can query and analyze accounting and financial information for companies you are authorized to access. List your authorized companies, review revenue, expenses and financial results, and compare reporting periods using natural-language questions. An active Contador Xpress/Xpress BI account and permission to access the selected companies are required. This version provides read-only queries.

defaultPrompt: Muéstrame el resumen financiero del mes pasado de una de mis compañías autorizadas.
Compara los ingresos, gastos y resultados de los dos últimos meses de mi compañía.
